xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4362: Model-placement eval suite: review recall, plan quality, summary faithfulness, feedback acceptance

plan.title: Model-placement eval suite: review recall, plan quality, summary faithfulness, feedback acceptance
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator-approved parent PRD (.pan/drafts/model-routing-2026-09.md, Issue B) scoped the four suites as one issue. They share one result-record store, one fixture loader and one five-model acceptance table; splitting into sibling issues would re-run the five-model matrix per issue and split the single results comment the acceptance criteria require. The file count is dominated by one test file per scorer (required by the issue) and one eval file per suite, each of which the lint counts as its own subsystem.

narratives.Problem: Overdeck places models per role from vendor benchmarks measured at max/xhigh effort, but launches at high. No Overdeck eval measures whether a review lane finds a real blocker, whether a planner writes a lint-clean xBRIEF, whether a summarizer invents facts, or whether a work agent acts on pan tell review feedback instead of treating it as prompt injection. PAN-4361 made the harness provider-neutral; the suites, fixtures, scorers and a cross-run results table are missing, and the harness cannot send a multi-turn conversation.
narratives.Proposal: Add four Evalite suites (E2 review-recall, E3 plan-quality, E4 summary-faithfulness, E5 feedback-acceptance) on the PAN-4361 harness. Pure scorers live in evals/lib with offline unit tests; fixtures come from real Overdeck PR reviews, committed specs/PRDs and scrubbed session excerpts, loaded through a credential-scanning loader. Suites reuse production code (renderPrompt planning template, lintPlanQuality, an extracted parseXBriefDocument, extracted summary-prompts builders, exported renderExternalHandoffPrompt, buildTranscriptTitlePrompt). Each case appends a JSONL result record; evals/report.ts renders the five-model placement table and E2 single-family finds. The harness gains a multi-turn messages option for E5.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to any model default, role placement, workhorse, or config value (issues D-G and parent PRD section 6 own that).
- No pipeline-level head-to-head runs (E6, PAN-3054).
- No LLM-as-judge scorer; every score is computed mechanically.
- No edits to roles/*.md or any production prompt text; eval-mode instructions live only in eval user prompts.
- No behavior change in smart-compaction, summary-fork, or xBRIEF reading; the extractions are byte-identical refactors.
- No CI wiring or npm test inclusion for live evals.
- No long-context (>=272K) fork-summary stress cases.
- No security review-lane cases in E2.
- No committed eval result JSONL files; no allowlist cap raises.

autoDecisions.summary: Add an optional multi-turn `messages` input to runPromptScenario instead of flattening E5 into one user string.
autoDecisions.rationale: The behavior under test (Sonnet 5.5 treating a mid-task user message as injection) needs a user turn that arrives after assistant turns.

autoDecisions.summary: Store per-case results as gitignored JSONL under evals/results/ and render the table with evals/report.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Evalite keeps only per-run data; a cross-run store is the only way to compute E2 single-family finds and the five-model table. Runs are local and cost money, so the posted issue comment is the durable artifact.

autoDecisions.summary: Reuse production code through small extractions: parseXBriefDocument from readPlanSync, summary-prompts.ts from smart-compaction.ts, export renderExternalHandoffPrompt.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says reuse the xBRIEF validator and lint rather than copy; smart-compaction.ts is at its 1148-line allowlist cap, so the prompts must move out rather than gain an exported builder in place.

autoDecisions.summary: E2 fixtures come from merged PRs with a "# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for" comment whose reviewed SHA is still reachable; security-lane blockers are excluded.
autoDecisions.rationale: Those comments name a real blocker with file:line, lane and the reviewed/base SHAs; E2 gates only correctness/performance/requirements placement.

autoDecisions.summary: E3 includes the case PRD text in the prompt and picks 8 closed issues that have both a committed spec and a PRD.
autoDecisions.rationale: A no-tools single-shot planner cannot discover files; real planning agents read the PRD, which names the files.

autoDecisions.summary: E4 hallucinations = unsupported identifiers (paths, issue ids, SHAs, backticked identifiers absent from the source) + decoy violations; hard fail only for handoff and compaction.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mechanical and reproducible without an LLM judge; the hard-fail scope is exactly what the issue states.

autoDecisions.summary: E5 has six inline cases including one control injection that must be refused or flagged.
autoDecisions.rationale: Without a control, a model that obeys anything would score perfectly.

autoDecisions.summary: Per-suite output caps (review 32K, plan 48K, summaries 16K, title 4K, feedback 8K) and Evalite testTimeout raised to 600 s.
autoDecisions.rationale: Opus 5.5 at effort high writing a full xBRIEF would exceed the current 180 s timeout and the catalog 128K cap wastes budget.

autoDecisions.summary: claude-haiku-4-5 rows report effort n/a; "at effort high" means DEFAULT_EFFORT wherever the model enumerates effort levels.
autoDecisions.rationale: The harness rejects OVERDECK_EVAL_EFFORT for a model with no effortLevels, so Haiku cannot run at an explicit high.

autoDecisions.summary: The results-table item is an implementation checkpoint: measured rows for reachable models, runnable-command rows for the rest, plus a pan tell to the flywheel.
autoDecisions.rationale: At planning time the agent environment had neither ANTHROPIC_API_KEY nor OPENAI_API_KEY and gpt-6-sol is not served by CLIProxy; only gpt-6-luna is reachable.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the four suites in one issue with plan.metadata.sizeJustification rather than splitting into siblings.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator-approved parent PRD scoped them as one issue sharing one store and one acceptance table.
